title: Grandma Sitting Outdoors, 1960 B&W Lawn Chair Snapshot
description: A square black-and-white snapshot from August 1960 showing an elderly woman sitting relaxed in a folding lawn chair in a grassy yard. She wears eyeglasses and a patterned summer shift dress. Behind her is a quiet suburban residential neighborhood featuring a single-story house, trees, and a classic 1960-era automobile parked on the street. The front white deckled margin is stamped SEP 60 by the developer and bears a handwritten blue ink caption reading Aug-1960 - Grandma.
